ways.label: Takahue Saddle Road to Makene Road

start.name: junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road
start.quote: junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road

ways.time: 10-12 hr (allow extra time, may take much longer in poor track and weather conditions)
evidence: The track starts at the junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road.
The track ends at Makene Road.
If you need transport back to Kaitaia, arrange this before you go.

ways.label: Alternative track exit via Mangamuka Summit Track to SH1

start.name: junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road
start.quote: junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road

evidence: Alternative track exit: turn left at the 727 m high point and follow the Mangamuka Summit Track down through podocarp forest to end at SH1 in Mangamuka Gorge.

doubts: No feature is listed for the start (Takahue Saddle Road / Warner Road junction) or the end (Makene Road), so both have no ref.
